CHAPTER III

POWER-UPS

✦

POWER-UP CUBES

Up to three float ahead of the line each play. Run through one to grab it. The AI grabs them too.

TURBO PADS

Four turbo pads sit on the field, two near each 30-yard line.

TURBO PADAn orange pad with a lightning bolt on it and a spinning gold bolt floating above. Run over it to refill about 60% of your turbo meter. A used pad goes dark and recharges in about 7 seconds.
— 3 —
CHAPTER IV

SPECIAL MOVES

✦

Specials start empty and charge as plays finish. Knocking someone out adds 25%. Using one empties the meter.

— 4 —
CHAPTER V

PASSING & HITS

✦

PASSING

Hike with A / J. The center snaps it to your quarterback. While he holds it behind the line, a button floats over each receiver: X / K left, B / Space right, Y / L your troll. Press that button and the ball homes in on him. A defender right on him when it arrives can pick it off or swat it.

SACKS & BIG HITS

A quarterback tackled behind the line explodes. Turbo a heavy player into a light one to demolish him. K.O.'d players drop back in from the sky a few seconds later.

— 5 —
CHAPTER VI

BRAWLS

✦

A pick, a halftime scuffle or a Sudden Death tackle turns into a side-view, one-on-one fight. It plays like a classic arcade fighter: up always jumps, down always crouches, and forward / back follow the way you face.

THE SIX BUTTONS

High PunchU · X button · Square
Low PunchJ · A button · Cross
High KickI · Y button · Triangle
Low KickK · B button · Circle
Block (hold)L · LB / RB · L1 / R1
Run (hold + forward)Shift · LT / RT · L2 / R2

Move with WASD / arrows / left stick. Up jumps (up + forward or back jumps that way), down crouches. On a phone the six fight buttons appear during the fight.

MOVES

Down + HPUppercut · launches for a juggle
Down + LP / HK / LKCrouching punch / high kick / low kick
Back + HKRoundhouse · knocks down
Back + LKLeg sweep · trips
Jump + punch / kickAir punch / flying kick · beat a crouching block
Close HP / HKHead strike / knee
LP up closeThrow · beats blocking

BLOCKING

Standing block stops high, mid and jump-in attacks. Crouching block (down + block) stops mid and low attacks, and high attacks miss a crouching fighter. You can't attack while holding block, and blocked hits push you back with a short block stun.

COMBOS

Tap the buttons in order; each one can come before the last move finishes. A combo that connects can't be interrupted. Uppercuts, knees and roundhouses pop the opponent up so you can keep hitting while they're in the air.

FIGHT BUTTONS

WINNING

K.O. or more health when the timer runs out wins (interceptions and halftime fights 15 seconds, Sudden Death 10, Arena 30). The loser explodes.

— 6 —
CHAPTER VII

KICKING

✦

Inside the opponent's 40 a Field Goal card appears in your play call (key F). A football swings across a track; press A / J when it's between the yellow posts. The farther the kick, the faster it swings. Their wizard may fireball the ball out of the air, but it rarely connects. Good kicks are worth 3. You get the same shot at their kicks on defense: press Y / L to fire.

EXTRA POINTS

After a touchdown (6 points) you get an extra point try from the 3: kick it for 1, run any play for 2, or call the Fake Field Goal, which lines up like a kick before the holder runs or throws it.

SKELETON SKY BLOCK

When blocking, press B / Space and your skeleton hops onto the orc's or troll's back. Press it again to leap off as the ball is kicked. Time it right and he swats it out of the air (not on Troll Toss, where the troll throws him instead).

— 7 —
CHAPTER VIII

LATE HITS

✦

When a play ends, the fight keeps going for about 4 seconds. The ball and score are locked in, but everyone can still move and hit.

STOMPS & LATE HITS

Press A / J near someone on the ground to stomp them flat; stomp again (or stomp with an orc or troll) and they explode. Y / L fires a free late-hit move: wizards throw fireballs that set people on fire, orcs and trolls slam the ground, knights shield-bash, skeletons dash. A charged special still works and uses up your meter. Explosions knock nearby players into each other. Press the skip key to jump to the next play.

— 8 —
CHAPTER IX

2 PLAYERS

✦

Pick 2 PLAYERS on the title screen. Each player can use their own controller, or share one keyboard: P1 on the left (WASD move, F pass, G punch, E special, Space hop, Q switch, Left Shift turbo) and P2 on the right (arrows move, . pass, / punch, ' special, Right Ctrl hop, ; switch, Right Shift turbo). One player can also use keyboard and mouse while the other uses a controller. Both players pick plays at the same time.
